summary: Kewaunee Scientific Corporation filed an 8-K on August 25, 2026, solely announcing that it plans to release its first quarter fiscal 2027 earnings on September 9, 2026, after market close. The press release, furnished as Exhibit 99.1, provides no financial results, terms, or strategic actions. This is a routine earnings-date notification with no special-situation elements, such as M&A, activist activity, or capital restructuring. The event is administrative and does not trigger any special-situations classification. Nothing to watch operationally; the only forward item is the scheduled earnings release.
